question: Do the selected balls encoders bind objects, and do the reviewed paired results satisfy the originally declared P25 bars?
hypothesis: Object binding, positional decodability and action planning are distinct; reconstruction loss alone cannot establish any of these downstream claims.

sources.sections: Section 4, Metrics, and Appendix A image metrics
sources.consequence: Score decoder masks by best intersection-over-union; distinguish per-image binding from temporal tracking. Include background area in each mask union.

sources.sections: Appendix D.2, Appendix G, Appendix B discussion
sources.consequence: Freeze the selected RGB encoder; latent Hungarian goal cost and object-mask binding measure different properties. Neither establishes a recovered causal graph.

sources.sections: Appendix A.10, full probe methods and Table 10; Section 5.1
sources.consequence: Report current and future positional probes separately from planning. Local C001 probes use 4096 training windows and ridge 0.001, rather than the paper's 50000 and 1e-6, so do not call them an exact reproduction.

sources.sections: Fixed paired task and episode-bootstrap protocol
sources.consequence: Compare identical episode/start/horizon/CEM-seed cases; retain training seeds separately and bootstrap paired episode differences.

sources.sections: P25 items 3 and 4; active execution revision
sources.consequence: Implement the missing IoU >=0.5 binding report and the pre-existing planning/probe bars without changing models, thresholds or selecting results.

differences: The primary binding measure is per-frame best IoU against each full geometric disc, with pixel centres as sim.balls defines them (equivalently rendered alpha >=0.5). It is not VideoSAUR's video mBO or a tracking metric. Overlap/occlusion is retained; visible painted-disc area and a >=90% visible subset are diagnostics. C001's fixed sorted-white/global-latent probe convention remains unchanged; all local probe adaptations are explicit.
contrary_evidence: Good image masks may switch identity or encode poor dynamics. Full discs can overlap, while hard slot masks partition the image; low binding may partly reflect occlusion. A strong L0 or weak L1 is a mismatch with the reference phenomenon, not grounds to tune the test or discard the run.

binding.starts: same deterministic current-frame selection as C001 probes
binding.mask: argmax over decoder slot masks, no label-dependent threshold
binding.truth: all n+1 geometric discs at pixel-centre radius <=3

comparison.seeds: n3 seeds0/1/2 for L0/L1/O0/O1; n1/n6 seed0 L0/L1/O1
comparison.primary: H4 O1-L1 >=-0.10 and O1-L0 >=0.30 at each n; report H6/H8 and O0 separately
comparison.reference: n3 L0 H4 <0.10 and mean red-coordinate Pearson <0.5; L1 H4 >=0.5
comparison.probes: n3 O1 each current coordinate r>=0.9; each white coordinate at four steps r>=0.8
comparison.uncertainty: paired episode difference CI, 2000 bootstrap samples; no pooling training seeds
comparison.missing: show incomplete or technically blocked evidence explicitly; never convert a missing cell to zero or a pass
comparison.review: all numeric input results must have a passing or measured-negative literature review; stale/unreviewed results block aggregation

success: All declared measures and bars can be reproduced from reviewed per-case artifacts; this record has no new training or model-performance threshold.
stop: Do not use test masks or probes for checkpoint selection or hyperparameter tuning. Do not run a new full GPU stage concurrently with the preserved trainers. Report partial evidence as incomplete.

resources.allocation: within the existing B/C allowance, not an additional allowance
